1.e4 c5 2.Nf3 e6 3.d4 cxd4 4.Nxd4 Nc6 5..strategy: Grabs space: the c4 pawn defends the b5 knight and takes d5 away, so Black cannot free the game with ...d5 and has to play a slow, cramped but solid game. The price is time, since the knight will be chased, and a weakened d4 square.

Attacks the undefended e4 pawn, so White has to commit another piece to its defence, while Black prepares ...a6 to kick the b5 knight. White ends up moving the same knight again and again for space; Black trades time for a compact, solid set-up and counterplay against the pawn centre.
